metadata.name: Looking for Ludovico
metadata.description:
This mod will tell you if the Item 'The Ludovico Technique' is present at any treasure room of a level. The source code of this mod can be found at [url=https://github.com/dpv927/LookingForLudovico]GitHub[/url].
[h1]Features[/h1] [list] [*] When the item is found, a message will be displayed near the player and Isaac will do the thumbs up emote. [*] The message will not disappear unless the player moves to another room. [/list]
[h1]Fixes (Version 1.7)[/h1] [list] [*] Some adjacent rooms to the treasure rooms showed up in the map as visited. This is now fixed in the current version. [/list]
[h1]Important Note[/h1] Since [url=https://github.com/filipondios/looking-for-ludovico/tree/b651cb3efbe24b0181c9a08f9896a5ad69c8aef2]version 1.6[/url], this mod caused the golden treasure room in Greed mode to stay open and does not seem to be a primitive solution. Therefore, Greed mode won't be supported by this mod until this issue is solved.
